blocks.text: By accessing or using the Hosmos platform ("Platform"), operated by HelpH D.O.O., a company incorporated in Slovenia ("Company", "we", "us"), you ("User", "you") agree to be bound by these Terms of Service ("Terms"). If you do not agree, you must discontinue use of the Platform immediately.

These Terms constitute a legally binding agreement between you and the Company. By creating an account, completing the onboarding wizard, or subscribing to any plan, you confirm that you have read, understood, and accepted these Terms in their entirety.
Hosmos is a B2B SaaS platform designed for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) to:

items: Calculate greenhouse gas emissions across Scope 1, Scope 2, and Scope 3 (GHG Protocol)
Manage 100+ non-financial ESG parameters (Environment, Social, Governance)
Auto-generate compliance reports aligned with CSRD/ESRS, GRI 2021, CDP Climate, UN Global Compact, EU Taxonomy, TCFD, and SBTi standards
Manage supply chain ESG questionnaires and track decarbonisation goals

blocks.text: Feature availability depends on the subscription tier selected by the User (Trial, Starter, Pro, or Enterprise).

To use the Platform, you must create an account by providing accurate and complete information. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your login credentials and for all activities that occur under your account.
You must notify us immediately at [support@hosmos.io](mailto:support@hosmos.io) if you suspect any unauthorised access to your account.

Hosmos is sold as an **annual subscription**: Starter (EUR 300 per year), Pro (EUR 1 000 per year) and Enterprise (EUR 2 000 per year), each for a 12-month term. A free 30-day Trial precedes a subscription. All prices are exclusive of VAT and other applicable taxes unless stated otherwise. What each plan includes is set out on the pricing page and in the plan comparison inside the Platform; the same limits apply in the contract.
4.1 Right to Modify Pricing
The Company reserves the right to modify subscription prices, the features included in each plan and the structure of the plans. Such changes may include, but are not limited to:

items: adjusting the annual subscription fee of any or all plans,
adding, removing or reassigning features between plans,
introducing new plans or discontinuing existing ones,
applying charges for add-ons or services agreed separately.

blocks.text: 4.2 Notice of Price Changes

We will provide at least **30 days' prior written notice** of any pricing change by e-mail to the address associated with your account. The notice will state the new price, the effective date and any change to the plan's features.
4.3 Effect of Price Changes

A price change applies from the **next renewal** of your subscription, never within a term that has already been paid for. If you do not agree with the new price, you may cancel before the renewal date; the subscription then ends with the current term.
4.4 Billing, Term and Refunds

The subscription fee is charged **in advance for the whole 12-month term** via Revolut when the subscription starts and at each renewal. The Platform is a business service (B2B); the fee for a term that has begun is **not refunded**, in whole or in part, if you stop using the Platform or cancel before the term ends — cancellation takes effect at the end of the paid term (Section 12). The Trial exists so that you can evaluate the Platform before paying. Failed renewal payments start a grace period of 7 days, after which the account is limited to read-only access until payment is resolved.
4.5 Renewal

Unless cancelled through the account settings before the renewal date, the subscription renews for a further 12-month term at the price in force at that time (Section 4.2). We remind you of the upcoming renewal by e-mail at least 30 days in advance.
New users receive a 30-day free trial with access to Scope 1 and Scope 2 calculation, the onboarding wizard, and a single PDF report export. No credit card is required to start a trial.

At the end of the trial period, your account will be limited to read-only access. To continue using the Platform, you must subscribe to a paid plan. Trial data is retained for 90 days after trial expiration.
6.1 Data You Provide

You provide corporate ESG data including but not limited to: energy consumption, emissions data, workforce composition, governance structures, supplier information, and other non-financial parameters. You retain ownership of all data you submit.
6.2 Data Use for Analytics and Product Development

blocks.intro: By using the Platform, you acknowledge and agree that the Company may use your data, in **aggregated and anonymised form**, for the following purposes:
items: **Analytics:** To generate industry benchmarks, sector-level emission averages, ESG performance indices, and aggregated statistical reports
**Product Development:** To improve the Platform's algorithms, emission factor databases, calculation methodologies, user experience, and feature set
**Machine Learning:** To train and improve internal models for data validation, anomaly detection, auto-classification of ESG parameters, and predictive analytics
**Research & Reporting:** To publish anonymised industry reports, white papers, and sustainability insights that do not identify individual companies

blocks.text: 6.3 Data Sharing with Third Parties
The Company may share aggregated and anonymised data with:

items: Research institutions and industry bodies for ESG benchmarking purposes
Technology partners and sub-processors necessary for Platform operation (subject to Data Processing Agreements)
Regulatory authorities when required by law

blocks.text: We will **never** sell your individually identifiable company data to third parties. All shared data will be sufficiently aggregated and anonymised so that no individual company can be identified.
6.4 Data Retention

Your data is retained for the duration of your active subscription plus 12 months after account termination. You may request full data export or deletion at any time in accordance with your rights under GDPR (see Section 9).

The Platform, including its design, code, algorithms, emission factor databases, report templates, and all associated intellectual property, is owned by HelpH D.O.O. and protected by applicable copyright, trademark, and trade secret laws.

You are granted a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable licence to use the Platform for the duration of your subscription. You may not reverse-engineer, decompile, or create derivative works from the Platform.
Any aggregated insights, benchmarks, or derived datasets produced by the Company from anonymised user data are the intellectual property of the Company.
You agree not to:

items: Submit knowingly false, misleading, or fraudulent ESG data
Use the Platform to misrepresent your company's environmental or social performance (greenwashing)
Attempt to gain unauthorised access to other users' accounts or data
Use automated tools to scrape, extract, or harvest data from the Platform
Resell access to the Platform without a valid Enterprise or white-label agreement
Interfere with the Platform's infrastructure or security mechanisms

blocks.text: The Company processes personal and corporate data in accordance with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR, Regulation 2016/679). Key provisions:

items: **Data Residency:** All data is stored within the European Union
**Legal Basis:** Data processing is based on contractual necessity (Art. 6(1)(b)) and legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f)) for analytics and product development
**Your Rights:** You have the right to access, rectify, erase, port, and restrict processing of your data. Contact [privacy@hosmos.io](mailto:privacy@hosmos.io) to exercise these rights
**Data Processing Agreement:** A DPA is available upon request for all paying subscribers, as required by Art. 28 GDPR
**Sub-processors:** We maintain a current list of sub-processors available at {{hosmos.io/sub-processors}}

blocks.text: We implement industry-standard security measures including: AES-256 encryption at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit, row-level security for data isolation, multi-factor authentication, immutable audit logging, and regular third-party penetration testing (OWASP Top 10).
While we take all reasonable steps to protect your data, no system is completely secure. You acknowledge that you provide data at your own risk.
To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law:

items: The Platform is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind, express or implied
The Company shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, consequential, or punitive damages arising from your use of the Platform
The Company's total liability shall not exceed the total fees paid by you in the 12 months preceding the claim
The Company does not guarantee that ESG calculations will meet specific regulatory audit requirements. Users are responsible for verifying data accuracy with qualified professionals

blocks.text: You may cancel your subscription at any time through your account settings or by contacting [support@hosmos.io](mailto:support@hosmos.io). Cancellation takes effect at the **end of the paid 12-month term**; the fee already paid for that term is not refunded (Section 4.4), and you keep full access until the term ends.
The Company may suspend or terminate your account if you violate these Terms, engage in fraudulent activity, or fail to pay subscription fees after the grace period.
Upon termination, you may export your data within 30 days. After this period, data will be retained in accordance with our data retention policy (Section 6.4) and then permanently deleted.

blocks.text: The data controller is HelpH D.O.O., registered in the Republic of Slovenia. For all privacy-related inquiries, contact us at [privacy@hosmos.io](mailto:privacy@hosmos.io).
We collect the following categories of data:
Account Data
Name, email address, company name, job title, and password hash. Collected during registration and required to operate your account.
Company ESG Data

Energy consumption, emissions data, fleet and transport information, workforce composition, governance structures, supplier information, and other non-financial parameters you submit through the Platform.
Usage Data
Pages visited, features used, session duration, device type, browser type, IP address (anonymised after 30 days), and interaction patterns. Collected automatically to improve the Platform.
Billing Data
Payment method details are processed directly by Revolut and are never stored on our servers. We retain only transaction IDs, plan type, and billing history.

head: Purpose
Legal Basis (GDPR)
rows: Providing the Platform and calculating ESG indicators
Training ML models for data validation and benchmarking
Publishing anonymised industry research and benchmarks

blocks.text: We share data only in the following cases:

items: **Sub-processors:** Neoserv (hosting), Supabase (database), Revolut (payments), and an email service provider. All sub-processors have signed Data Processing Agreements.
**Aggregated analytics:** Anonymised, aggregated data may be shared with research institutions and industry bodies for ESG benchmarking. No individual company can be identified.
**Legal requirements:** When required by law, court order, or regulatory authority.

blocks.text: We do **not** sell your personal or company data to third parties. We do **not** use your data for advertising purposes.

items: All data is stored within the **European Union**
Encryption at rest: AES-256
Encryption in transit: TLS 1.3
Tenant isolation: PostgreSQL Row-Level Security
Authentication: OAuth 2.0 with optional MFA (TOTP / WebAuthn)
Backups: continuous with RPO 1h / RTO 4h
Audit logging: immutable, timestamped logs of all data access

blocks.text: Under GDPR, you have the following rights:

items: Access
Request a copy of all data we hold about you
Rectification
Correct inaccurate or incomplete data
Erasure
Request deletion of your data ("right to be forgotten")
Portability
Receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format (JSON/CSV)
Restriction
Restrict processing of your data in certain circumstances
Objection
Object to processing based on legitimate interest
Withdraw consent
Where processing is based on consent, withdraw it at any time

blocks.text: To exercise any of these rights, email [privacy@hosmos.io](mailto:privacy@hosmos.io). We will respond within 30 days.

Hosmos sets **necessary cookies** without asking, because the site cannot work without them (ePrivacy Directive Art. 5(3); ZEKom-2 Art. 225). **Analytics cookies** are set only after you choose “Accept all” in the cookie banner; choosing “Only necessary” keeps them off and the site works exactly the same. You can change your choice at any time via “Cookie settings” in the page footer or in Settings.

blocks.text: We use **Google Analytics 4** (property G-FNT7ZJBFER, processor Google Ireland Limited, Gordon House, Barrow Street, Dublin 4, Ireland) to count visits to the PUBLIC pages of hosmos.eu — the landing page, the VSME page, this policy and the sign-in and registration screens. Pages inside an account (your organisation, inventory, disclosures, reports) are not measured at all: no page view, no session, no identifier of yours reaches Google from them. It is loaded ONLY after you choose “Accept all”: until then the script is not requested, no cookie is set and no request reaches Google. Choosing “Only necessary” — at any time, via “Cookie settings” in the footer — stops the measurement. Before a page address is sent, it is stripped of the query string and of every identifier in it, so “/sl/evidence/:id” is reported and the record it was opened for is not. The property is not used for advertising, remarketing or audience export, and Google acts as our processor under Art. 28 GDPR; transfers to the United States rely on the EU-US Data Privacy Framework.
We do not use advertising or cross-site tracking cookies. If we connect another analytics tool, this section is updated with its cookie names and retention before it goes live.

head: Data Type

rows: As required by tax law (typically 10 years)
